record.field: How do I create a partner account?

field.name: answer
field.p: Choose Create account on the sign-in page and submit your business contact details. Our team reviews the registration before enabling partner-only purchasing permissions.

record.field: What can I do while my account is pending approval?

field.name: answer
field.p: You can browse public products, update your profile, contact sales, and follow requests. Partner pricing and checkout remain subject to your account permissions.

record.field: Why can’t I see product prices?

field.name: answer
field.p: Price visibility is controlled by your company approval, customer segment, and assigned Odoo pricelist. Contact sales if your approved account still does not show prices.

field.name: answer
field.p: MOQ is the minimum order quantity for the selected product and configuration. The quantity control follows the applicable Odoo unit of measure and pricelist rule.

record.field: Where can I track my order?

field.name: answer
field.p: Open My Account → Orders to review quotations, payment attempts, confirmed orders, and available fulfilment information.

record.field: What should I do if a payment fails or is cancelled?

field.name: answer
field.p: The quotation remains available in your account. Open it again to review the transaction status and retry with an available payment method.

record.field: Do product samples have a cost?

field.name: answer
field.p: Yes. After approval, the sample request becomes an Odoo quotation. Review the quoted product, tax, and delivery amounts and complete payment before fulfilment.

record.field: How do I track a sample request?

field.name: answer
field.p: Open My Account → Sample Requests. The request shows review, quotation, payment, order, and ERP fulfilment status.

record.field: How do I request warranty or after-sales service?

field.name: answer
field.p: Use Project Support to submit an order-linked service request. Select the purchased product and provide the fault details and supporting evidence.

field.name: answer
field.p: Production and transit time depend on stock, customization, destination, and freight method. See Shipping and Delivery for planning estimates; your confirmed quotation is authoritative.

record.field: Where can I download manuals, certificates, and media?

field.name: answer
field.p: Open Downloads to search the resources available to your account. Product-specific resources also appear on the matching product detail page.
